_comment: THE code-block SOURCE-FIELD contract, as ONE file read by BOTH render engines (api/test/barkpark/portable_doc/render/code_source_alias_parity_test.exs and internal/pdrender/code_source_alias_parity_test.go). Not a mirror pair: a single file cannot drift. Accepted keys, in precedence order: value, code, content, text - the same order api/lib/barkpark/portable_doc/bpml/printer.ex has printed since it was written. Precedence is FIRST NON-BLANK (trim-normalized), so a blank leading alias falls through. `content` is an array of inline nodes and is flattened to its text. Regenerate nothing: hand-authored, both engines assert against it.

cases.name: value-only (the canonical shape every first-party producer writes)
code-only (Go mdlite + agent-authored corpus shape; 327 live rows)
both/conflict: blank value falls through to code
blank: whitespace-only across every accepted key
missing: no source key at all renders nothing
non-stringish: a map under value is not a source
unaccepted key: `source` is NOT an alias (diagram owns that field)
